title: 1950 AHSME Problem 21
statement: The volume of a rectangular solid each of whose side, front, and bottom faces are \(12\) square inches, \(8\) square inches, and \(6\) square inches respectively is:

solutions.text:
If the edge lengths are \(x,\) \(y,\) and \(z,\) then the three face areas are \(xy,\) \(yz,\) and \(xz.\) Therefore \[ \begin{aligned} (xyz)^2&=(xy)(yz)(xz)\\ &=12\cdot8\cdot6=576. \end{aligned} \] Since the volume is positive, \(xyz=\sqrt{576}=24\) cubic inches.

Thus, the correct answer is B.
hints: Let the three edge lengths be \(x,\) \(y,\) and \(z\)
Multiplying the three face areas gives \((xyz)^2\)
